info.name: Get Option Ladder by Base Symbol

params.name: expiry
params.description: Optional - Filter results by expiry date in YYYYMMDD format (e.g. 20250520)

params.name: type
params.description: Optional - Filter results by type (`CALL` or ` PUT`) of the option markets

params.name: sort
params.description: Optional - Sort results by Option Type or Expiry Datetime

items.docs: Returns the available options contracts. This data helps traders quickly assess the available options and their respective prices, implied volatilities, and Greeks (such as delta, gamma, theta, and vega).

params.name: symbol
params.description: symbol to get. Only option markets are supported.

items.docs: Returns the for a given `baseSymbol`, organized by strike prices and expiration dates. This data helps traders quickly assess the available options and their respective prices, implied volatilities, and Greeks (such as delta, gamma, theta, and vega).
Retrieves Expiry Price and Expiry Notional for respective Options and Dated Futures markets.
